recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-18673 unless a future work-group decision reopens cross-cutting canonical URL/canonical reference terminology.
issue_request: FHIR-18673 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3. It asked to clarify confusing canonical URI wording, retain the canonical datatype because it carries canonical-reference expectations beyond uri syntax, explain url plus optional version resolution, keep resource .url elements typed as uri rather than renaming them, and avoid unqualified use of canonical as a noun.
initial_application: The Jira comment records git 6f7c3716ef. Commit 6f7c3716ef8e176e5ea811ceb12844b81a3904ec, 'GF#18673 - clarify language around canonical URLs', updated the datatype, references, ValueSet, CodeSystem, and related conformance wording from ambiguous canonical URI language toward canonical URL and canonical reference terminology.
additional_context: ValueSet is active in the current build through source/fhir.ini. Related audit commits already on the combined branch cover adjacent ValueSet URL, CodeSystem URL, canonical version/hash, and canonical target guidance; none supersede FHIR-18673. Earlier FHIR-15744/FHIR-14691 audits explicitly treat FHIR-18673 as the later canonical terminology decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current canonical datatype definition points to canonical resources with url properties and documents the version suffix and fragments; references.html explains canonical references to url plus optional version; and ValueSet source describes ValueSet.url as the canonical URL while retaining uri syntax.
